scope: Roadmap item 5: use EmuReady reports to choose reproducible game/device/configuration cases, starting with the owner's Helltaker, TF2 and Ghostrunner Demo.
method: EmuReady public mobile API (the same reader the app implements in app/src/main/feature/library/EmuReady.kt): games.batchBySteamAppIds, games.get (title fallback), listings.get, listings.byId. Note the payload is wrapped in result.data.json.

Team Fortress 2 (Steam 440).note: No entry at all - neither batch lookup nor title search returns it. Community data cannot anchor this case.

Ghostrunner Demo.note: No demo entry. AppID 1382070 is Viewfinder, not the Ghostrunner demo; the demo is not indexed.

cases.reported_settings: Proton-10.0-arm64ec-2; Turnip_Gen8_V25; DXVK 2.7.1; FEXCore 2603; Box64 preset Performance; FEXCore preset Extreme
cases.notes: Runs at 60 fps with very occasional graphical artifact, does not affect gameplay.

findings: The two Helltaker reports are both on the GameHub emulator and both rate it Perfect on a Snapdragon 778G and a Dimensity 8300 Ultra - two different GPU vendors.
The only Ghostrunner report is the Epic Games edition on a Snapdragon 8 Elite handheld via GameNative. The owner's case is a Steam demo, so edition and storefront differ.
Team Fortress 2 and the Ghostrunner Demo have no community reports at all.
No report is on Vapor; every one is on another emulator. These are reference configurations, not Vapor-verified results.
implication_for_the_phone_session: Helltaker is the strongest anchor: two independent devices/SoCs, both Perfect, and it is the owner's own confirmed working case.
Ghostrunner can be run, but any comparison must note the Epic/Steam edition difference and the different emulator.
TF2 and Ghostrunner Demo must be qualified from scratch - there is no community baseline to reproduce.
Suggested order: Helltaker first (known good), then Ghostrunner (note edition), then TF2 / Ghostrunner Demo (no baseline).
limitations: Community reports are other people's results on other emulators and hardware; they are not evidence for Vapor.
Reports carry no controlled frame-time or battery data.
